claim: Coca-Cola reports $12 million revenue for fiscal third quarter of 2023
summary: Coca-Cola did report fiscal Q3 2023 results, but net revenue was ~$11.95 billion (~$11,953 million), not $12 million. The claim is off by ~1000x and confuses million for billion.

sub_claims.text: Coca-Cola reported financial results for the fiscal third quarter of 2023
sub_claims.stated_text: Coca-Cola reports ... for fiscal third quarter of 2023
sub_claims.note: Coca-Cola (KO) fiscal year ends Dec 31; fiscal Q3 2023 ended Sept 29, 2023 and was reported Oct 24, 2023.

sub_claims.text: Coca-Cola's reported revenue for that period was $12 million
sub_claims.note: Actual reported net operating revenue for Q3 2023 was ~$11,953 million (~$11.95 billion). $12 million understates true revenue by ~1000x; the numerical magnitude ~12 is correct for billions, not millions.

sub_claims.text: The revenue figure refers to total net revenue for the quarter (as opposed to another metric)
sub_claims.note: Whether interpreted as GAAP net revenues, net sales, or operating revenues, no Coca-Cola revenue measure for Q3 2023 was $12 million; all were in the ~$12 billion range.
